title: Design Research Intake
description: Validates client intake data for the WordPress design research prompt generation framework.

CLIENT_CONTEXT_BLURB.description: Casual 2-3 sentence intro framing the research request. Sets tone and focus for the entire report.

BUSINESS_NAME.description: Full legal or operating business name as used publicly.

BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION.description: One to three sentence description covering what the business does, who they serve, and where they operate.

INDUSTRY.description: Industry category with optional sub-category (e.g., 'Construction / Commercial Plumbing').

PROJECT_START_DATE.description: Project start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

SITE_TYPE.description: Whether this is a new site, redesign, or full overhaul.

HAS_DOMAIN.description: Whether a domain name is already registered (Yes/No).

HAS_HOSTING.description: Whether hosting is already in place.

WEBSITE_URL.description: Target URL for the finished site.

DOMAINS_LIST.description: All domains and subdomains owned, comma-separated.

REQUIRED_PAGES.description: Comma-separated list of pages the client wants on the site.

CLIENT_TYPE.description: Whether clients are B2B, B2C, or Both.

CLIENT_TYPE_LABEL.description: Short label derived from CLIENT_TYPE, used in report section headers.

SERVICE_AREA.description: Geographic coverage area. Be as specific as possible.

TARGET_CLIENTS.description: Specific client segments the business serves.

HAS_BRANDING.description: Whether existing brand guidelines or style guide exists.

COLOUR_PALETTE.description: Brand colors (names, hex codes, or both).

INSPIRATION_SITES.description: Reference websites with notes on what the client likes about each.

SOCIAL_MEDIA.description: Social media platforms the business is active on.

CONTENT_STATUS.description: Whether content for the site is ready.

LAUNCH_DATE.description: Target launch date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

LANGUAGE_NEEDS.description: Whether the site needs multiple language versions.

KEY_SERVICES.description: Top 5-10 services in order of revenue importance.

CERTIFICATIONS_CREDENTIALS.description: Professional certifications, licenses, insurance coverage, and industry memberships.

TESTIMONIALS_REFERENCES.description: Existing client testimonials or references with names, titles, and companies.

UNIQUE_SELLING_POINTS.description: What makes the business different from competitors.

COMPETITOR_NAMES.description: Main competitors the business competes against.

ELEVATOR_PITCH.description: 30-second pitch explaining why a client should hire this business over a competitor.

REVENUE_MODEL.description: How the business makes money and the split between revenue streams.

BUSINESS_HISTORY.description: How long the business has been operating and notable milestones.
